description:
Fantom Corporation is seeking a Software Engineer Level 0 to develop, maintain, and enhance software systems supporting mission requirements. This entry-level position involves software design, coding, testing, debugging, and integration. The engineer will work independently or as part of a team to turn documented requirements into reliable software.
Clearance: Fully cleared before starting, with a polygraph completed within the last seven years

Key Responsibilities
 

 
 Analyze user requirements to identify software design and performance requirements.



 
 Design and develop new software or modify existing applications to add features.



 
 Debug existing software, correct defects, and resolve reported software problems.



 
 Review and test software components for compliance with design requirements and document test results.



 
 Integrate existing software into new or modified systems and operating environments.



 
 Develop simple queries for existing or proposed databases and data repositories.



 
 Apply software development and design methodologies appropriate to the development environment.



 
 Recommend improvements to documentation and software development process standards.



 
 Contribute to software design decisions involving hardware and software tradeoffs, software reuse, and commercial or government off-the-shelf products.



 
 Support requirements analysis from the system level to individual software components.






Required Qualifications

 Must be fully cleared with a recent MD polygraph 

 Must be willing and able to work fully onsite at the location listed in this posting 


 

 
 No prior professional software engineering experience is required when the education requirement is met.



 
 Demonstrated experience with Linux.



 
 Must be fully cleared before starting, with a polygraph completed within the last seven years.






Education
 
 

 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline from an accredited college or university.



 
 Four years of software engineering experience on projects using similar software processes may substitute for the bachelor’s degree.






 #CJ



Fantom Corp is a Software Development, Agile Cloud, Cyber Security (Risk Management, Assessments & Authorization (A&A)), Data, AI Platform (Computer Vision Models), Podcasting Media Services, and IT Services provider. Established in 2015, Fantom Corp serves Federal customers with top-notch Cybersecurity Architects, Data Scientists/Analysts, Software Engineers/Developers, DevSecOps Engineers, Project Managers, Identity, Credential Access Management (ICAM) services , and Cloud-certified practitioners. We excel in delivering emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) with a focus on identifying trends, object detection, and classification of structured and unstructured data. Fantom Corp possesses mastery in all aspects of digital audio production. We lead in the ideation and creation of efforts for clients who want to harness the power of podcasting. We guide them in selecting the right show format for their needs and goals. As a Small Business, we possess the innovation, speed and flexibility to meet your requirements.
